# Rules Encyclopedia

## Core Game Rules

### Character Creation

| Step | Action | Time |
|------|--------|------|
| 1 | Choose Race | 2 min |
| 2 | Choose Class | 2 min |
| 3 | Roll Stats | 1 min |
| 4 | Name Character | 1 min |
| 5 | Backstory | 5 min |

### Stats System (D20)

| Stat | Abbreviation | Base | Per Level |
|------|-------------|------|----------|
| Strength | STR | 10 | +2 |
| Dexterity | DEX | 10 | +2 |
| Constitution | CON | 10 | +2 |
| Intelligence | INT | 10 | +2 |
| Wisdom | WIS | 10 | +2 |
| Charisma | CHA | 10 | +2 |

### Combat Rules

| Action | AP Cost | Accuracy |
|--------|---------|----------|
| Attack | 1 | 1d20 + STR/DEX |
| Defend | 1 | +2 AC |
| Cast Spell | 2 | Spell DC |
| Move | 1 | - |
| Dash | 2 | Double speed |
| Disengage | 1 | - |
| Dodge | 1 | Advantage |
| Grapple | 1 | Athletics |
| Shove | 1 | Athletics |

### Skill Checks

| Difficulty | DC | Examples |
|------------|---|----------|
| Easy | 10 | Climb ladder |
| Medium | 15 | Pick simple lock |
| Hard | 20 | Disable complex trap |
| Very Hard | 25 | Persuade noble |
| Nearly Impossible | 30 | Climb sheer wall |

### Saving Throws

| Stat | Saves Against |
|------|-------------|
| STR | Grapple, forced movement |
| DEX | Traps, fireballs |
| CON | Poison, disease |
| INT | Illusions |
| WIS | Charms, fears |
| CHA | Polymorph |

### Experience & Leveling

| Level | XP Required | Proficiency Bonus |
|-------|-------------|------------------|
| 1 | 0 | +2 |
| 2 | 300 | +2 |
| 3 | 900 | +2 |
| 4 | 1,800 | +2 |
| 5 | 3,400 | +3 |
| 6 | 4,800 | +3 |
| 7 | 6,400 | +3 |
| 8 | 8,500 | +3 |
| 9 | 10,000 | +4 |
| 10 | 12,000 | +4 |

### Equipment Slots

| Slot | Equipment |
|------|------------|
| Head | Helmet, crown |
| Neck | Amulet, cloak |
| Body | Armor, robes |
| Hands | Gloves, bracers |
| Feet | Boots, sandals |
| Ring (2) | Rings |
| Weapon | Sword, staff |
| Off-hand | Shield, torch |

### Encumbrance

| Load | Speed Penalty |
|------|---------------|
| Light (STR?5) | None |
| Medium (STR?10) | -10 ft |
| Heavy (STR?15) | -20 ft |
| Overburdened | Cannot move |

### Death & Dying

| HP State | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| 0 HP | Unconscious, death saves |
| Negative CON | Death save at disadvantage |
| -HP ? CON | Instant death |
| 3 failed saves | Dead |
| 3 succeeded saves | Stable |
